You can freely accept, refuse or customize your consent: 
by clicking on 'Accept', you consent to the use of all cookies, including profiling cookies, also from third-party; by clicking on 'Customise', you can confirm your preferences after selecting the purposes you are interested in in the box below, where you can also view the details of each individual cookie category (“Setting” command); by clicking on 'Close and accept necessary cookies only', you will install only the strictly necessary cookies, and consequently reject all other types (including profiling cookies).
